JNU students accuse professor of sexual harassment; probe initiated

Students at Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) have accused a professor of sexual harassment. The university has initiated a probe into the allegations. The specific details of the accusations and the professor's response were not immediately available in the coverage. The probe is currently underway.
